note: post-Wave-1 behavior (dns/wave1-root-fixes: semaphore decoupling, deadline-owned rotation with RTO budgets + cold-start full-deadline, throttle-clears-breaker, logical failure counting, typed DNS_TIMEOUT classification). Worst of 3 seeded local runs. failed_ratio = dns_failures / 600 logical lookups; counting is per-ARM (a TXT+CNAME pair that both fail counts 2), so an all-fail profile reads 1.8 (480 fast-path pairs x 2 + 120 root = 1080), never the pre-fix 2.45 of per-attempt inflation. Remaining honest defects held by this baseline for Wave 2: p4 in-window lookups still fail (386-390 arms; deferred-retry rescues them in Wave 2) and the burst still multiplicatively collapses the limit once per signal (backoff 239-241; one-decrease-per-epoch lands in Wave 2). p3/p6 carry a small cold-start tail (4 and 2 failed arms) permitted by the cold-start budget contract. Pre-fix baseline (2026-08-20, for history): p1 wall 5844 ratio 0.0 (the old equal-budgets code passed p1 by giving attempt 0 the whole 3 s); p3 ratio 0.115 backoff 0.0924; p4 ratio 0.7534 down 1; p5 ratio 2.4467; p6 ratio 0.075.
